---
name: Study, correction or recipe
about: Bring a paper, correct a claim or suggest a recipe for the guide.
---

## What should change?

Name the food, drink or existing page and the question a reader wants answered.

## What was studied?

Link the paper. Include who took part, the food or drink, dose, timing, comparison group and measured outcome. Include the result and a limitation or conflicting finding if available. For a cold-season study, specify whether it measured symptoms, days of illness or how many people caught a cold.

## What goes in the kitchen?

For a new recipe, give the ingredients, amounts, preparation and yield. Explain any differences from the study preparation.
